_note: SYNTHETIC demo data written by the team to show the workflow. Not real guests. Raw text only: the app runs the on-device models on it when you press Analyze.

guests.name: Marco
guests.liked: Macinare il caffè cantando con la famiglia è stato bellissimo. Il pranzo era delizioso.
guests.improve: La strada per arrivare era molto difficile. Vorrei comprare un sacchetto di caffè da portare a casa.

guests.name: Sophie
guests.liked: La balade dans la ferme avec la vue sur le Kilimandjaro était magnifique. La famille est très accueillante.
guests.improve: Les toilettes n'étaient pas propres. Nous aurions aimé acheter du café torréfié.

guests.name: Li Na
guests.liked: 自己烘焙和研磨咖啡非常有意思。午饭很好吃。
guests.improve: 厕所需要改进。我们想买一些咖啡豆带回家。

guests.name: Emma
guests.liked: Grinding the coffee while the family sang was the highlight of our trip. The banana beer was fun to try.
guests.improve: The road up was very bumpy and hard to find. I would have bought roasted coffee beans if they were for sale.

guests.name: Amani
guests.improve: Njia ni mbaya wakati wa mvua.

guests.name: James
guests.liked: Learning how the coffee is grown and processed was fascinating. Lovely views of the waterfall.
guests.improve: It was hard to understand some of the explanations without a translator.
